messages:
rachel: quick brain dump: what if we add a diurnal headroom layer for dedicated pools that smooths prewarms based on historical hour-of-day+weekday patterns. goal: reduce cold starts during predictable spikes without blowing budget.

tom: interesting. how does this differ from current prewarm heuristics?

rachel: current is reactive + simple burst. diurnal layer would proactively maintain a small rolling baseline (per-shard) using an exponential moving average over same-hour history. small footprint only.

priya: love it, but need clear operator invariants. admission API must stay tiny. we shouldn't add new verbs. prefer: AllocateLease(tenant_id, slots, priority, metadata). metadata can be free-form annotations like `prewarm: diurnal` so controllers can opt-in.

carlos: ops concern: reclaimability. prewarmed slots must be reclaimable within N seconds for higher-priority traffic. suggest we attach `lease_flags: [reclaimable]` and expose reclaim metrics.

rachel: agreed. implementation note: keep prewarm nodes in a separate tagging pool so scheduler can evict them quickly. eviction path must be <500ms for our P95 SLO.

tom: metrics we need: diurnal_baseline, diurnal_utilization_pct, evict_latency_p95, diurnal_budget_remaining. add a dashboard tile and alert when budget_remaining < 10% or evict_latency_p95 > threshold.

priya: budget model: per-tenant daily cap + global circuit-cap. when tenant cap is hit, degrade to reactive prewarm for that tenant. when global cap hit, stop all diurnal prewarms and send page.

carlos: also add a soft-fail mode for experiments: controller should be able to toggle `dry_run=true` to only emit telemetry without allocating. useful for validating forecast quality.

rachel: sample operator annotation idea: ```
annotations:
  prewarm.strategy: diurnal
  prewarm.window: "06:00-20:00"
  prewarm.alpha: "0.2"  # smoothing factor
  prewarm.max_daily_budget: "cpu-hours:10"
```

tom: test plan: - sim replay of last 60 days traffic with and w/o diurnal layer - assert cost delta < +3% and cold-start reduction > 30% - assert circuit-cap trips under synthetic storm

priya: rollout: feature-flagged per-shard -> start in telemetry/dry-run for 2 weeks -> small-budget enabled on non-critical shard -> expand. include rollback toggle that immediately drains prewarms.

infra-bot: CI pipeline: branch feature/diurnal-headroom queued. unit tests 5/5, integration stub failing (known). :construction:

rachel: i'll draft a short RFC with API snippet, runbook (how to drain, how to force-disable), and dashboard mocks. pinging @tom @priya for review. thanks! :sparkles:
